# opstracer_integration (Resource)

An alert source integration: an ingest endpoint and routing key that a monitoring tool sends alerts to for one service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opstracer_integration" "checkout_datadog" {
  service_id        = opstracer_service.checkout.id
  name              = "checkout-datadog"
  type              = "datadog"
  default_severity  = "P3"
  rate_soft_per_min = 300
  severity_mapping = {
    critical = "P1"
    warning  = "P3"
  }

  # Change this value to issue a new routing key.
  rotate_key_trigger = "2026-10"
}

output "checkout_datadog_url" {
  value = opstracer_integration.checkout_datadog.integration_url
}

output "checkout_datadog_key" {
  value     = opstracer_integration.checkout_datadog.routing_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Integration name.
- `service_id` (String) ID of the service the alerts belong to. Changing it replaces the integration.
- `type` (String) Alert source type, e.g. `generic`, `datadog`, `grafana`. Changing it replaces the integration.

### Optional

- `default_severity` (String) Severity (`P1` to `P5`) for alerts that carry none. Server default is `P3`.
- `rate_hard_per_min` (Number) Alerts per minute above which events are dropped. Must not be below `rate_soft_per_min`. Server default is 6000.
- `rate_soft_per_min` (Number) Alerts per minute above which ingestion is throttled. Server default is 600.
- `rotate_key_trigger` (String) Any value; changing it issues a new routing key and retires the old one immediately. After an import the first value is adopted without rotating.
- `severity_mapping` (Map of String) Maps the source's own severity values to OpsTracer severities (`P1` to `P5`).
- `status` (String) `active` or `disabled`. Defaults to `active`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `integration_url` (String) Ingest URL the alert source posts to.
- `routing_key` (String, Sensitive) Routing key the alert source authenticates with. Only known when Terraform created or rotated it; null after import.
- `token_hint` (String) Last characters of the current routing key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The routing key cannot be read back, so routing_key is null after import.
terraform import opstracer_integration.checkout_datadog <integration-id>
```
